cards.say: One kilometre equals how many metres? One thousand metres.
one metre equals? cm and? mm. one hundred centimetres and one thousand millimetres.
one kilogram equals? g, one tonne equals? kg. one thousand grams and one thousand kilograms.
one litre equals? mL. one thousand millilitres.
three point two kilometres in metres. three thousand two hundred metres
six hundred and fifty centimetres in metres. six point five metres
zero point zero eight metres in centimetres. eight centimetres
four thousand five hundred millilitres in litres. four point five litres
zero point three five litres in millilitres. three hundred and fifty millilitres
one point two five kilograms in grams. one thousand two hundred and fifty grams
two point five tonnes in kilograms. two thousand five hundred kilograms
seven centimetres five millimetres in millimetres. seventy five millimetres. seven times ten equals seventy and seventy plus five equals seventy five.

cards.front: Which is heavier, 2.5 kg or 2,050 g?
cards.say: Which is heavier, two point five kilograms or two thousand and fifty grams? two point five kilograms, because two point five kilograms equals two thousand five hundred grams.

cards.front: How many seconds in 1 minute? How many minutes in 1 hour?
cards.say: How many seconds in one minute? How many minutes in one hour? sixty seconds and sixty minutes.
How many seconds in one hour? three thousand six hundred. sixty times sixty equals three thousand six hundred.

cards.front: How many days in a leap year?
cards.back: 366. February has 29 days in a leap year.
cards.say: How many days in a leap year? three hundred and sixty six. February has twenty nine days in a leap year.
three point five hours in hours and minutes. three hours thirty minutes. zero point five hour is thirty minutes.
zero point two five hour in minutes. fifteen minutes. A quarter of sixty.
Fourteen forty five in twelve hour time. Two forty five in the afternoon.
Three thirty in the afternoon in twenty four hour time. Fifteen thirty. Add twelve to the hour.

cards.front: How long is it from 09:40 to 11:15?
cards.back: 1 hour 35 minutes. 09:40 to 10:00 is 20 minutes, then 1 hour 15 minutes more.
cards.say: How long is it from nine forty to eleven fifteen? One hour thirty five minutes. Nine forty to ten is twenty minutes, then one hour fifteen minutes more.

cards.front: A film starts at 18:50 and lasts 2 hours 25 minutes. When does it end?
cards.say: A film starts at eighteen fifty and lasts two hours twenty five minutes. When does it end? Twenty one fifteen.

cards.front: Which is more: 90 minutes or 1.25 hours?
cards.say: Which is more: ninety minutes or one point two five hours? ninety minutes. one point two five hours equals seventy five minutes.

cards.front: A train leaves at 22:30 and arrives at 02:10. How long is the journey?
cards.back: 3 hours 40 minutes. 22:30 to midnight is 1 h 30 min, then 2 h 10 min more.
cards.say: A train leaves at twenty two thirty and arrives at two ten. How long is the journey? Three hours forty minutes.
